phases.title: Wave 1a — refetch household context after subject mutations

outputs.notes: Added two new integration tests covering SubjectForm onSuccess and SubjectsAllTable onMutate. Both call refetch() from useHousehold() in addition to the existing subjectRefreshKey bump (covers feedback 50774221 / fcee6fd0). Both new tests pass; pre-existing unrelated failure 'shows school year panel when tab query is school-year' confirmed failing on this branch before this change too. Build passes.

LessonGenerationPanel now consumes useHousehold() for studentProfiles and allSubjects. Renders a learner multi-select (checkboxes, reusing the SubjectForm pattern), a #generation-course-select <select data-testid="generation-course-select"> filtered to subjects where learnerIds intersects selectedLearnerIds and isActive, and a 'Save to plan' button (data-testid="save-to-plan-button") rendered only when generated.length > 0, disabled until a learner + course are selected. onClick is NOT wired yet (deferred to phase 1b-save). All 4 new tests pass; full features/resources suite (41 tests) and npm run build pass. ResourcesPage tests unaffected (LessonGenerationPanel not rendered in those tests since 'selected' stays null).

phases.title: Wave 1b — wire Save to plan to plannerApi.createLesson

outputs.notes: Added mapGeneratedLessonToTaskInput (pure mapping fn) to features/resources/server/service.ts, covered by 2 new resources.test.ts unit tests. NOTE: this exported helper is NOT imported into LessonGenerationPanel.tsx (server/service.ts transitively imports repository.ts -> getDb(), which would pull DB/drizzle code into the client bundle); the component instead inlines the equivalent mapping. 'Save to plan' onClick now loops plannerApi.createLesson() once per selected learner x generated lesson, mapping {childId, subjectId: selectedCourseId, householdId: studentProfiles.find(...).householdId, title, description, dueDate, status: 'not_started', order} (resourceLink omitted — Resource type has no URL field to source it from). Shows 'Saving…' state while in flight, a confirmation message 'N lessons added to the planner' on success, and disables Save to plan again until the next Generate lessons run (resets saved/messages). All 44 features/resources tests and npm run build pass. Covers feedback e534c6cc. Manual QA still needed: generate lessons on /resources, save, then confirm they appear on /lessons and the Weekly Planner with correct due dates.

Added QURAN_SESSION_TYPE_LABELS map ('New memorisation' -> 'New memorization (Hifz)', 'Memorisation' -> 'Memorization review (already memorized)') and sessionTypeLabel(type) helper (falls through to the raw type for other SESSION_TYPES) in QuranPage.tsx. Applied to all SESSION_TYPES <option> renders (Log session form, filter dropdown, inline edit form) and to the session-list type display; value={type} (stored value) is unchanged in every case. Added 3 new integration tests. PRE-EXISTING UNRELATED FAILURE: at this branch's merge-base (5aabb36), QuranPage.test.tsx already fails 10/15 -- every test involving the 'Edit session'/Pencil inline-edit flow times out at ~8000ms with 'useLearner must be used within LearnerProvider' errors, unrelated to this change. Of the 3 new tests, 2 directly cover the 2a acceptance criteria and pass ('shows friendly session-type labels in the Log session form and filter dropdowns', 'shows the friendly review label for an existing session with type Memorisation'). The 3rd ('shows the friendly label in the inline edit dropdown for an existing session') depends on that same pre-existing broken inline-edit flow, so it was marked it.skip with a comment explaining why -- re-enable once the inline-edit flow is fixed (out of scope for this phase). Final run: 10 failed / 1 skipped / 7 passed (18 total) -- failure count matches the pre-existing baseline exactly (10/15 at baseline since this phase added 3 tests, 1 of which is skipped). npm run build passes. Covers feedback 80f04cd0.

Added LessonCadence = 'schoolDay' | 'weekly' | 'everyNDays' and optional cadence/cadenceDays fields to GenerateLessonsInput (features/resources/types.ts). generateLessons() now delegates due-date calculation to a new computeDueDates() helper: cadence 'weekly' steps 7 calendar days apart from startDate, 'everyNDays' steps cadenceDays (clamped to >=1) calendar days apart, and 'schoolDay'/undefined preserves the existing Mon-Fri weekday-stepping behavior unchanged (all 4 pre-existing generateLessons tests still pass). Also fixed a latent timezone bug while implementing this: startDate (an ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' string) was being parsed with `new Date(startDate)` (UTC midnight), which shifts to the previous local day in negative-UTC-offset timezones (e.g. America/New_York) -- added parseLocalDate() to parse YYYY-MM-DD as a local-time Date, used for all cadence modes including schoolDay. handleGenerateLessons (features/resources/api/routes/resources.ts) now validates cadenceDays >= 1 (number) when cadence === 'everyNDays', returning a 400 'error' response otherwise; cadence/cadenceDays otherwise pass through to generateLessons() unchanged via the existing `body as GenerateLessonsInput` spread. Added 2 new resources.test.ts tests (weekly: 2026-09-01/08/15/22; everyNDays cadenceDays=3: 2026-09-01/04/07/10), both pass. Full features/resources suite (46 tests) and npm run build pass. UI wiring (Pacing select + N input in LessonGenerationPanel, wired to resourcesApi.generateLessons) is phase 2b-pacing-ui.
